context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly falls through from an empty follow-up list to the register/tech-debt/value-rubric pools instead of stopping at 'nothing to report', per Rule 2 and the first Anti-Pattern.

checklist.name: States zero ACTIVE explicitly
checklist.description: Report states the follow-up count is zero ACTIVE, out of 15 total, all DONE

checklist.name: Falls through to wider backlog
checklist.description: Does not stop at the zero-follow-up result; proceeds to the register and tech-debt pools

checklist.name: Accurate open-row counts
checklist.description: 38 open RISK_REGISTER rows and 7 open TECH_DEBT rows (or an equivalent accurate count) appear

checklist.name: Freshness check performed
checklist.description: Compares the index's header count against the actual file count before trusting it

checklist.name: Value-rubric pool considered
checklist.description: Applies the value-rubric read protocol over PLAN/FINDING/KNOWN_ISSUE entries as part of the wider pool

checklist.name: Single named recommendation
checklist.description: Exactly one recommended next item is named, not a list of equally-weighted options

checklist.name: Rationale beats runner-up
checklist.description: States why the pick beats the next-best alternative, not just that it won

checklist.name: Judgment-call labeling
checklist.description: If the pick is register/tech-debt-sourced, explicitly labels it a qualitative judgment call, not rubric-sorted

checklist.name: No mutation performed
checklist.description: No file is edited; no register/tech-debt row filed or modified; no follow-up status changed

checklist.name: Handoff offered, not executed
checklist.description: Offers a next-step handoff (risk-register / tech-debt / plan-create) rather than performing it
